campaign.title: Oriented outside-v-side cancellation of the moving top-pole edge

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use exact finite-contour Cauchy algebra, Mellin inversion, endpoint expansion, and Hilbert-transform analysis. Search primary literature only if a named finite-section Hilbert or Plemelj theorem is proposed, and audit orientation and uniform-parameter hypotheses.

frozen_target.question: Does the exact oriented sum of the finite v-vertical, its two outside-v sides, and the v=0/u=0/corner ledger cancel the logarithmic moving hard-top edge uniformly in L=alpha-beta, and does the resulting amplitude satisfy the scaled C^2 bounds required by the accepted two-saddle Fresnel lemma?
frozen_target.reference_formula: At finite height C_(a,V)(L)=int_(-V)^V H_b(nu)/(a+i(L-nu))dnu has C_(a,V)(V)=-iH_b(V)log(1/a)+O(1). Start from the exact finite vector contour rule: moving the v-line retains the upper left-to-right side minus the lower left-to-right side, plus the v=0 residue and the u=0/v=0 corner when crossed. Keep the omega-recombined radial factor and take no whole-line PV limit before deriving this oriented identity.
quantities: upper and lower oriented outside-v sides
u=0 top residue and joint corner
scaled C^2 Fresnel amplitude or exact obstruction

completion_criteria: The exact oriented finite v-side identity is written with all signs and residues.
The log coefficient is matched against every possible cancelling side term.
The physical top limit and height exhaustion order are justified or rigorously obstructed.
Uniform L/alpha derivatives are proved or their first failure is isolated.
A blind rederivation and hostile audit independently assess the cancellation.
The conductor closes the round before choosing a new objective.

tasks.target: Independently derive the exact oriented finite v-contour identity containing the truncated moving-pole integral, both outside-v sides, v=0 residue, u=0 residue and corner, and omega-recombined radial factor. Compute the coefficient and sign of every logarithmic edge term. Do not estimate the full beta trace.
required_output: Exact finite oriented identity and log coefficient ledger
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Evaluate the oriented outside-v sides in the moving-pole coordinate, prove cancellation or target control of the finite-height logarithm, and derive the resulting uniform scaled C^2 amplitude and nested exhaustion. If false, isolate the smallest exact surviving boundary kernel.
required_output: Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Hostilely audit side orientation, moving-pole endpoint convention, Plemelj signs, axial/top/corner double counting, omega recombination, order of limits, and uniform derivatives. Construct an actual-profile falsifier or certify the narrowest exact reconciliation.
required_output: Seven-section report at the assigned path
